FIRE

22 ways to keep your goal in sight.

Quiet typography, a distant horizon, a small adventure. Give every widget its own style, and preview the sizes available on your device.

Record, then get on with life.

Confirm your assets when it suits you. Optional review reminders and a history of records keep the process light.

See a possibility, not a promise.

An optional accumulation plan estimates progress and time remaining. Recorded assets never grow automatically.

Keep it yours.

No FIRE account, no bank connection. Core features work offline; iCloud sync is optional and off by default.

All features are free. Optional one-time support; no subscription.
